whatsNew:
A little room to wonder: daily physics reasoning challenges.

Work through a few connected ideas about forces, pressure, buoyancy, energy and equilibrium. Make a prediction, check the assumptions, and keep or revise your answer. Open hints at your pace, then explore the explanation, source links and a variation.

Simple introductions are optional. Related reviews return a few days later, and your notebook keeps the concepts you have explored and reviewed. There is no timer, leaderboard, reasoning score or streak to lose.

Predictions and personal notes stay on your device and are included in your Tend backups.
reviewNotes:
New in 1.2: authored daily conceptual physics reasoning, fully bundled offline.

1. Focus tab: scroll below the warm-up to A LITTLE ROOM TO WONDER and tap Explore an idea. No login, subscription, network or setup is required.
2. Tap Explore today’s idea. Conditions are explicit. Choose a prediction, optionally add a reason, then tap Consider the assumptions. Keep or revise the prediction and optionally note what changed your mind.
3. Hints open individually; See how it works submits, or Reveal the explanation works without any prediction. Read stepwise reasoning, alternative feedback and linked sources. Tap I’ve explored the explanation to save completion.
4. Change one condition offers an optional authored variation. The reasoning desk offers practice and two optional simple introductions. A related review is offered three local calendar days after daily completion. Reasoning has no timer, scores, leaderboard or lost streak.
5. Predictions, optional personal notes, hints and progress stay in app-local storage and are included in Settings > Export backup / Restore backup. No AI service or analytics receives them. The 14 daily questions and their explanations are authored content; no runtime question generation.

The existing focus timer, local reminders, notebook, attention warm-up, Siri, Live Activity and optional Screen Time app blocking are retained. Source links open externally. No data is collected.
